# data/raw

**These files are SYNTHETIC**, generated by `python -m tools.make_fixture`.
They are written in the same formats the real upstream sources emit, so the
ingest parsers do real parsing work and can be pointed at genuine scrape
output with no code change.

Replace file-by-file with real scrape output as it lands. Nothing downstream
needs to change when you do.

Note: agmarknet.gov.in has been rebuilt as a SPA whose API is captcha-gated;
the `__VIEWSTATE` postback flow described in SPEC.md 5.1 no longer exists.
